cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: And in this video, I'm going to show you how to use computer use.
cues.zh: 這次要示範如何使用 Computer Use。

cues.en: And computer use is a loaded word in AI terms, because many people associate it with a browser.
cues.zh: 在 AI 領域，這個詞有點容易混淆，很多人會把它和瀏覽器操作聯想在一起。

cues.en: Computer use is essentially just taking screenshots of the screen and pressing X and Y coordinates.
cues.zh: Computer Use 本質上是擷取螢幕畫面，再依 X、Y 座標點擊。

cues.en: Computer use has evolved mostly into browsers, but it can also take over your Windows machine.
cues.zh: 它多半被應用在瀏覽器，但也能接管 Windows 電腦。

cues.en: So it can do it.
cues.zh: 確實能這麼做。

cues.en: Codecs have it built in, and the other AI agents have it.
cues.zh: Codex 與其他 AI 代理程式都有內建。

cues.en: The drawback of computer use is that it's actually taking over the machine.
cues.zh: 缺點是它真的會接管電腦。

cues.en: In browser use, it's mostly just automating a browser, but in computer use, it's actually using your mouse cursor
cues.zh: Browser Use 主要自動操作瀏覽器，而 Computer Use 則會實際使用滑鼠游標，

cues.en: and looking at the screen, which can be incredible and expensive.
cues.zh: 並讀取整個畫面，因此可能很昂貴。

cues.en: We are going to see that as well.
cues.zh: 稍後也會看到用量。

cues.en: It also makes it difficult for me to demo this, because while it's running, I cannot show anything.
cues.zh: 這也讓示範很困難，因為執行時我不能操作其他東西。

cues.en: I cannot have a debugger in on it, because then what we're going to automate goes out of view.
cues.zh: 也不能同時除錯，因為除錯器會遮住要自動操作的畫面。

cues.en: So what I will do is I will just show you the task.
cues.zh: 因此我會先展示任務，

cues.en: I will run the code, see the full demo, and then we can look at the code after the fact.
cues.zh: 執行完整示範，再回頭看程式碼。

cues.en: Another thing you need to think about is while computer use can do a lot of things, it's rarely needed, to be honest,
cues.zh: 另外要考慮，雖然 Computer Use 能做很多事，老實說卻很少真正需要，

cues.en: because if you begin to see what you do on your machine, so you could, for example, say, oh, I wanted to go in and check the Windows Event Viewer
cues.zh: 因為仔細想想你在電腦上做的工作，例如到 Windows 事件檢視器，

cues.en: if there's any error messages.
cues.zh: 檢查是否有錯誤訊息，

cues.en: Yes, it could do that with computer use, but it can just as easily just read the files on the machine.
cues.zh: 確實能用 Computer Use，但直接讀取電腦上的記錄檔也很容易。

cues.en: Then you might say, oh, I wanted to change a setting in my computer.
cues.zh: 又例如想修改電腦上的設定，

cues.en: It can probably do that with some command anyway.
cues.zh: 通常也能透過某個指令做到。

cues.en: So I always see computer use as an absolutely last resort, because it's so intense and expensive,
cues.zh: 所以我一直把 Computer Use 視為最後手段，因為操作密集、成本高，

cues.en: and you can't really do anything on your machine while it's doing it.
cues.zh: 而且它工作時，你幾乎不能使用自己的電腦。

cues.en: Because, for example, I'm using computer use right now on my other screen while recording this, and it's uploading a YouTube video for me in my browser.
cues.zh: 例如我現在一邊錄影，另一個螢幕的瀏覽器自動化正在幫我上傳 YouTube 影片。

cues.en: If it had used computer use to do that, I would not be able to use my machine at all right now.
cues.zh: 如果那是完整的 Computer Use，我現在就完全不能使用電腦。

cues.en: But enough talk. Let's see the demo, and then let's talk about the code after the fact.
cues.zh: 先不多說，來看示範，之後再談程式碼。

cues.en: So the demo is run in MySamples under computer use, and in this case, OpenAI Responses API computer use,
cues.zh: 範例位於 Computer Use 下的 OpenAI Responses API Computer Use，

cues.en: because it's the Responses API who's in charge of this computer use.
cues.zh: 因為這個功能由 Responses API 提供。

cues.en: It's running it using a PC, a Windows PC, so it's not built for a Mac.
cues.zh: 這裡針對 Windows PC 實作，不支援 Mac。

cues.en: That would need some other tools in order to do that.
cues.zh: Mac 需要另外的底層工具。

cues.en: But again, we are going to make this task, in this case, in order to just see what it can do.
cues.zh: 這次只設計一個任務，看看它能做什麼。

cues.en: So I will ask it to start my Windows calculator, make a calculation for me, copy that calculation, start Notepad,
cues.zh: 我要它啟動 Windows 小算盤，完成計算，複製結果，再啟動記事本，

cues.en: copy the calculation over, and write some extra text in the system.
cues.zh: 把結果貼上，並輸入一些額外文字。

cues.en: Made-up thing because, again, there's so few uses, but if this was, for some reason, something we needed to do,
cues.zh: 這是刻意設計的例子，因為真正需要這種方式的情況不多；但如果確實有需求，

cues.en: then it could be done this way.
cues.zh: 就可以這樣做。

cues.en: So I'm just going to run this.
cues.zh: 接著直接執行。

cues.en: It might fail because I'm going to try and move the different screens onto the view where you can see, and they often start up on the other page,
cues.zh: 可能會失敗，因為應用程式常在另一個螢幕開啟，我得試著移到你看得到的位置，

cues.en: so I might move them while it's actually reading them and taking screenshots, but hopefully it will go away. Let's see.
cues.zh: 但它可能正好在讀取或截圖時被我移動，希望不會造成問題。看看。

cues.en: It is now starting up.
cues.zh: 現在正在啟動。

cues.en: We see over here.
cues.zh: 看這邊。

cues.en: It started the calculator.
cues.zh: 它啟動了小算盤。

cues.en: It was already on the screen, so that's okay.
cues.zh: 原本就在畫面內，所以沒問題。

cues.en: Now I moved the mouse, so things go wrong.
cues.zh: 我現在動了滑鼠，可能就會影響操作。

cues.en: It's very difficult to get this to work properly.
cues.zh: 這真的很難好好示範。

cues.en: Now it's doing the calculations.
cues.zh: 現在開始計算。

cues.en: We can see it pressed a bunch of keys.
cues.zh: 可以看到它按了一連串按鍵。

cues.en: It pressed Enter, pressed Control-C.
cues.zh: 按 Enter，再按 Ctrl+C。

cues.en: Now it's starting a Notepad, and I try to move it in.
cues.zh: 接著開啟記事本，我試著把它移進來。

cues.en: See, I managed to do it before it continued.
cues.zh: 成功趕在它繼續之前移好了。

cues.en: It pressed Control-N to get a new tab.
cues.zh: 它按 Ctrl+N 建立新分頁。

cues.en: It pressed Control-V to put in the calculation from the calculator.
cues.zh: 再按 Ctrl+V 貼上小算盤的計算結果。

cues.en: Now I can move the mouse again, and it wrote some text.
cues.zh: 現在可以移動滑鼠了，它也輸入了額外文字。

cues.en: And what we can see over here, it gave us some samples back, and we can also see it used 200,000 tokens to do this simple little thing.
cues.zh: 這裡回傳了一些結果，同時可以看到，這個簡單任務用了二十萬個 Token。

cues.en: So imagine you made an automation with computer use with much, much more steps.
cues.zh: 想像一下，如果用 Computer Use 做更多步驟的自動化，

cues.en: It will be very, very expensive to do.
cues.zh: 費用就會非常高。

cues.en: I'm also lucky that, in this case, GPT-6 Luna is good enough at this.
cues.zh: 這次也很幸運，GPT-6 Luna 的能力足以完成。

cues.en: In most cases, a GPT-6 Luna would not be able to do computer use in a good manner.
cues.zh: 但多數情況，GPT-6 Luna 不一定能把 Computer Use 做好。

cues.en: So sometimes this actually fails with Luna, and I need to go up to 6.1 Sol, which are very, very good at it.
cues.zh: 所以有時 Luna 失敗，我得升級到非常擅長這件事的 6.1 Sol。

cues.en: But now we have seen what it does.
cues.zh: 現在已經看過它的行為。

cues.en: Let me try and run it again and see if the things come up in the right places.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，看看視窗會不會出現在正確位置。

cues.en: Again, I'm not allowed to use the mouse right now.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，現在不能用滑鼠。

cues.en: That will break it.
cues.zh: 否則就會干擾它。

cues.en: Puts in the data.
cues.zh: 它正在輸入資料。

cues.en: Starts up Notepad.
cues.zh: 啟動記事本。

cues.en: Copy the data over.
cues.zh: 複製資料。

cues.en: Types the thing.
cues.zh: 輸入文字。

cues.en: It's behaving well.
cues.zh: 這次表現很好。

cues.en: Sometimes it writes the wrong thing.
cues.zh: 有時卻會輸入錯誤內容，

cues.en: Sometimes it copies the wrong thing because it didn't have access.
cues.zh: 有時因為沒有正確取得焦點，而複製錯東西。

cues.en: But again, 250,000 tokens in order to do this.
cues.zh: 這次同樣花了大約二十五萬個 Token。

cues.en: Let's look at some code.
cues.zh: 接著看程式碼。

cues.en: So, and again, I can't really set breakpoints or anything, so this is just going off what the code can do.
cues.zh: 因為很難設中斷點，所以主要是依照程式碼說明運作方式。

cues.en: It's a demonstration of it.
cues.zh: 這裡只是示範。

cues.en: And some of the code I have not written.
cues.zh: 而且其中有些程式碼不是我自己寫的。

cues.en: It's an AI who has written it because in order to do these things, click buttons and stuff in Windows,
cues.zh: 是 AI 協助完成，因為要在 Windows 點按鈕等操作，

cues.en: we need to go very, very low level in P invokes and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 需要透過 P/Invoke 等非常底層的機制。

cues.en: So see this as a reference example and then have your AI agent help with giving it more capabilities.
cues.zh: 請把它當成參考範例，再讓自己的 AI 代理程式幫忙增加功能。

cues.en: Because the first thing we have is what I call a desktop computer, and this is what can do the various actions that the system will do.
cues.zh: 首先是我稱為 DesktopComputer 的類別，負責系統能執行的各種操作。

cues.en: So the system will come back and say, hey, press this, move this, click this,
cues.zh: 模型會回覆要求按鍵、移動、點擊，

cues.en: do this keyboard combination, but also take screenshots.
cues.zh: 執行組合鍵，也會要求截圖。

cues.en: Because the way this works is that we are constantly sending screenshots to the AI.
cues.zh: 因為整個系統會不斷把截圖送給 AI。

cues.en: We are showing the entire screen, and it says, okay, click position,
cues.zh: 顯示完整畫面後，模型說要點哪個位置，

cues.en: 1,000 in x-coordinate, 200 in y-coordinate.
cues.zh: 例如 X 是 1000、Y 是 200。

cues.en: That's the way it works.
cues.zh: 就是這樣運作。

cues.en: And this is expensive, but as we see here, in order to work with my computer, I set it up.
cues.zh: 這很耗費成本，但先看如何設定電腦。

cues.en: I give it high DPI mode, and it's just a virtual screen.
cues.zh: 這裡啟用高 DPI 模式，並取得虛擬螢幕範圍。

cues.en: And then I say, whenever the AI wants to have a screenshot, go in and make a screenshot.
cues.zh: 每當 AI 需要截圖，就擷取畫面。

cues.en: And this is just C-sharp code of how to make a screenshot, get it back as a bitmap, and send it back to the system as bytes.
cues.zh: 這只是 C# 截圖程式，取得 Bitmap，再轉成位元組送回系統。

cues.en: And then we have execute async.
cues.zh: 接著是 ExecuteAsync。

cues.en: So we get in various types of things that need to be repressed.
cues.zh: 會接收各種需要執行的動作。

cues.en: We can either resolve keys, which is press some keys, or we can get these various things.
cues.zh: 可以解析按鍵，也可以處理其他操作。

cues.en: So it can be a click.
cues.zh: 例如點擊。

cues.en: And if you do a click, that would be what button should it be.
cues.zh: 點擊時，需要知道使用哪個滑鼠按鈕。

cues.en: And then we do a click, which is some low-level system things
cues.zh: 接著透過底層系統呼叫執行點擊，

cues.en: in that the mouse is going to be moved to a specific place and delay and stuff.
cues.zh: 把游標移到指定位置，再加入延遲等處理。

cues.en: And behind the scenes, you can see we end up with these DLM imports.
cues.zh: 背後最後會用到這些 DllImport。

cues.en: If you are old enough like me, you have actually perhaps done some of this in the past.
cues.zh: 如果年紀和我差不多，可能以前就做過。

cues.en: If this is new to you, this is very, very low-level C-sharp code going down to com-based objects that Windows 32 have.
cues.zh: 如果第一次看到，這是非常底層的 C#，直接呼叫 Win32 提供的功能。

cues.en: So this is a bunch of nerdy C-sharp code.
cues.zh: 所以這是一大堆偏底層的 C# 程式碼。

cues.en: It has nothing to do with AI.
cues.zh: 與 AI 本身沒有關係。

cues.en: So a person who is really good at automating Windows with code would easily read this and say, okay, yeah, let's type in this field.
cues.zh: 擅長用程式自動操作 Windows 的人，可以很容易理解這些程式，並加上輸入欄位，

cues.en: Let's do a key press. Let's scroll. Let's move.
cues.zh: 按鍵、捲動、移動，

cues.en: Let's drag things around and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 或拖曳等功能。

cues.en: So I'm not going to go into this code because I simply haven't gone in.
cues.zh: 我不會逐行解釋，因為自己也沒有完整深入研究。

cues.en: And to me, that is the groundwork of actually getting a machine to do anything.
cues.zh: 這是讓電腦真正執行操作的基礎。

cues.en: We're just giving the AI the option to use these things.
cues.zh: 我們只是讓 AI 能使用這些能力。

cues.en: So if we go back to here, that is our computer, and that is being used every time we do a screenshot.
cues.zh: 回到這裡，DesktopComputer 每次截圖都會被使用。

cues.en: And then it will use the different actions based on this response tool.
cues.zh: 它也會依照 Response Tool 的結果執行各種動作。

cues.en: And this comes from the responses API.
cues.zh: 這個工具來自 Responses API。

cues.en: So they have something called a response tool, and we need to set it up in this weird fashion model reader-writer where we get it from some binary.
cues.zh: 這裡需要用 ModelReaderWriter，從二進位 JSON 建立 ResponseTool，寫法稍微特殊。

cues.en: So again, we are much, much lower level than agent framework.
cues.zh: 所以我們操作的層級比 Agent Framework 更低。

cues.en: We are using agent framework a bit here, but we also need to go lower level in order to do this.
cues.zh: 雖然有使用框架，但仍需要直接處理底層功能。

cues.en: But we get a computer tool that we can give.
cues.zh: 最後會取得可提供給模型的 Computer Tool。

cues.en: It has an SAI tool, so it ends up being a tool like we normally do, but it's a bit more advanced what's happening behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 透過 AsAITool，它就成為一般工具，但背後流程比較進階。

cues.en: We will see that a little further on.
cues.zh: 稍後會繼續看。

cues.en: Then we have a normal tool.
cues.zh: 另外還有一個一般工具。

cues.en: This tool is just using process.info, so starting processes in Windows.
cues.zh: 這個工具使用 ProcessStartInfo，在 Windows 啟動程式。

cues.en: So if we give it calc.exe, it will start calculator, notepad.exe, it will start notepad.
cues.zh: 傳 calc.exe 就開小算盤，傳 notepad.exe 就開記事本。

cues.en: So this is the most normal part of this sample.
cues.zh: 這是整個範例最一般的部分。

cues.en: But there is a special thing in it that we actually say that this is a tool, but it's a declaration-only tool.
cues.zh: 但有個特殊設定：這個工具被標記為 DeclarationOnly。

cues.en: This was actually new to me when researching for this topic.
cues.zh: 我也是研究這個主題時才知道有這個功能。

cues.en: You can add tools to your agents, but this as declaration-only
cues.zh: 可以把工具加入代理程式，但 AsDeclarationOnly，

cues.en: will make it sure that agent framework itself don't execute the tool.
cues.zh: 會要求 Agent Framework 不要自行執行它。

cues.en: So normally you say, here I have this tool.
cues.zh: 一般會先提供工具，

cues.en: You ask a question to an AI.
cues.zh: 再向 AI 提出問題，

cues.en: The AI will come back and say, hey, I want to run this tool, and then agent framework will execute the tool, meaning it will run the C-sharp code.
cues.zh: AI 表示要呼叫某個工具時，Agent Framework 就會執行對應的 C# 程式碼。

cues.en: But in our case, we can't do that because it might be in the middle of the computer use.
cues.zh: 但這裡不行，因為工具呼叫可能穿插在 Computer Use 的過程中。

cues.en: So we can't let agent framework take care of it, and for that reason we tell it as declaration-only, and we will take care of running the tool after the fact.
cues.zh: 所以不能讓框架自動處理，必須標記為 DeclarationOnly，再由我們自己執行。

cues.en: We'll see that in a few lines here.
cues.zh: 下方幾行就會看到。

cues.en: We're then doing agent sessions because we are actually going to call the AI multiple times here, each time for one action being done,
cues.zh: 接著使用 AgentSession，因為這裡會反覆呼叫 AI，每次執行一個動作，

cues.en: new screenshot, new action, screenshot, new action, screenshot, new action, and so on.
cues.zh: 截圖、動作、截圖、動作，再繼續。

cues.en: So it's kind of advanced what's going on.
cues.zh: 因此整體流程比較複雜。

cues.en: We can actually try and say here, let's say, the chills, just so you can get a feeling for how often this is called.
cues.zh: 可以在這裡加個輸出，感受一下呼叫頻率。

cues.en: So let's do this, and you can see when we run it, take a screenshot, start the process,
cues.zh: 執行後可以看到，先截圖、啟動程式，

cues.en: take a screenshot, enter something, take a screenshot, enter something,
cues.zh: 再截圖、輸入、截圖、輸入，

cues.en: take a screenshot, start the process.
cues.zh: 然後又截圖、啟動程式。

cues.en: And each of these screenshots are high definition and a lot of tokens to be paid for.
cues.zh: 每張截圖都是高解析度，會使用大量 Token。

cues.en: So it's not like taking one screenshot and know everything.
cues.zh: 不是只拍一次，就能知道後面所有事情。

cues.en: Every time something changes on the screen, it needs to take a screenshot to enable it.
cues.zh: 每次畫面變更，都必須重新截圖讓它觀察。

cues.en: Now we can also see it made a little mistake here.
cues.zh: 現在也看到它犯了一點錯。

cues.en: So it's trying again, putting the text in.
cues.zh: 所以重新嘗試輸入。

cues.en: So it put in some extra words.
cues.zh: 它多輸入了一些文字。

cues.en: It does that sometimes.
cues.zh: 有時會這樣。

cues.en: Now it put in an extra dot.
cues.zh: 現在又多了一個句點。

cues.en: That's not good enough as well.
cues.zh: 這樣仍不符合要求。

cues.en: So it will probably try again.
cues.zh: 所以可能還會重試。

cues.en: Now it's really thinking about what it has done wrong. And, yeah.
cues.zh: 現在它仔細思考自己哪裡做錯了。

cues.en: So it let it be, despite it's actually not following the right rules.
cues.zh: 結果它決定就這樣，雖然其實沒有完全遵守要求。

cues.en: Again, our 6.1 sole will not do this mistake, but you can see just this single mistake made it almost double in token spend.
cues.zh: 6.1 Sol 通常不會犯這個錯；但可以看到，只是這個錯誤，就讓 Token 用量幾乎翻倍。

cues.en: And imagine paying this in the 6.1 sole or Astro prices.
cues.zh: 如果按照 6.1 Sol 或 Astra 的價格計費，

cues.en: This could become really, really expensive very, very fast.
cues.zh: 費用很快就會變得非常昂貴。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that was just our screenshot side note here.
cues.zh: 這是關於截圖用量的補充。

cues.en: So this is the first input.
cues.zh: 這是最初的輸入，

cues.zh: 我加上安全用的 MaxTurns，例如最多操作五十次，

cues.en: it will end up just stopping automatically for me.

cues.en: This, of course, can't be put in real life if it needs to do more than 50 turns of what you need to do.

cues.en: But in here, we call the agents, so we give it first the task, the original task, and a screenshot

cues.en: But else we get the response back as an open AI response.

cues.en: It will, of course, run the project.
cues.zh: 它會執行這個工具。

cues.zh: 再搭配我們自己掌控的底層工具，
